purpose: Define the hard-rule failures that disqualify or warn Macro Planner Candidate fixtures before weighted score interpretation.

rule_scale.major: Single occurrence may require manual review; two or more major failures disqualify.
rule_scale.minor: Does not disqualify alone; creates warning or review flag.
rule_scale.safety: Always disqualifies and blocks all promotion interpretation.

rules.definition: Candidate, fixture, scorecard, or report contains raw corpus prose or near-verbatim script text.
rules.required_action: Remove leaked content, regenerate metadata-only fixture, rerun scan.

rules.definition: Any provider call is made during Stage243 fixture evaluation.
rules.required_action: Discard run; mark as invalid for Stage243 evidence.

rules.definition: Actual live generation is performed rather than fixture-only envelope generation.
rules.required_action: Block run; keep Page18 runtime closed.

rules.definition: Fixture/report claims Macro Planner, Full Author, or Live Generation promotion from preflight evidence.
rules.required_action: Correct authority language; restore blocked status.

rules.definition: The season has no explicit macro objective, thematic promise, or dominant dramatic question.
The structure lacks an inciting force that changes the protagonist/system state and launches the season engine.
No midpoint turn or irreversible reorientation exists in the season/episode arc.
No crisis point forces a decisive cost, irreversible choice, or structural collapse before climax.
No climax resolves or transforms the central conflict established by the season arc.
An episode depends on information, action, relationship state, or payoff that has not yet been planted or caused.
A later event contradicts the stated cause/effect chain without deliberate explanation.
A plant, clue, motif, promise, or setup has no payoff target or closure path.
A payoff, reveal, reversal, or rescue appears without prior setup, plant, expectation, or causal basis.
A reversal occurs because the outline requires it, not because prior decisions and pressures force it.
A character belief, desire, status, morality, or agency state changes without triggering event or accumulated pressure.
Trust, intimacy, power, dependency, betrayal, or alliance shifts without preceding interaction or cause.
Episode endings fail to create forward propulsion beyond the configured threshold.
Scene-function distribution collapses into repeated CONFLICT/PERIL/HOOK without sufficient ESTABLISH/BOND/REVELATION/RELIEF rhythm.
Core and core2 labels form a pattern that does not match the stated scene role or macro position.
Multiple adjacent scenes perform the same function without escalation, contrast, or additional payload.
